notes.title: Demo release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I want to announce that the Demo version of the game is now available. You will be able to play the first level - Forest. Forgotten Fears is the second project that I am developing completely alone, so any feedback will be appreciated, it will allow me to fix any issues, rework something, or even add a new mechanic you would like to see in the level. Your feedback will allow me to understand my mistakes that I will try to avoid in the future.

I hope you will have fun playing the Demo!
